notes.title: Drunk Builder Simulator: Update
notes.notes:
Drunk builder Simulator Update


Improvements:
- fixed Dropping player under map
- Improved collisions of throwed poop
- Now chief are not ragdolling when fall
- Now ragdoll will not be activated when player jump on trampoline/net
- Now sprint dont take more percents/s
- Player is getting faster up after ragdoll
- Added ambience music
- minor fixes

Balance:
- Lowered alcohol percentages loss
- Lowered foremans damage
- Now one bottle of alcohol can last for longer
- Lowered stuff builders has to do to win match
- Mounting planks is now faster

New stuff:

1. New tool HAMMER
Now to find alcohol instead of interaction u have to hit box with Hammer
Hammer tool is avaible when player press on keyboard 3.
boxes are still respawning

[previewyoutube=Vi9TzZs2uqw;full][/previewyoutube]

2. New hittable object 
There are now propane tanks on the maps hit them with hammer to make a big explosion

[previewyoutube=lXrxdPd5R28;full][/previewyoutube]

3. New task for builders
Driving a rod into the ground
Added new task for builders, rods in the ground which requires to be hitting with hammer 3 times to complete

[previewyoutube=qegYwv5YDEU;full][/previewyoutube]
